# Best luxury real estate agencies in Brisbane

If you’re looking for prestige real estate in Brisbane, I’d shortlist agencies that combine a proven record with high-value homes, strong buyer networks, premium marketing and the ability to reach qualified buyers discreetly.

**My top three starting points are Ray White Collective Luxury, Queensland Sotheby’s International Realty and Place Estate Agents.** Each offers a different advantage, from ultra-luxury specialisation to international exposure and deep local market knowledge. These are recommendations based on specialisation and available track-record evidence, rather than a definitive ranking of every Brisbane agency. [www.raywhite.com](https://www.raywhite.com/news-media/matt-lancashire-launches-new-era-ray-white-collective-luxury?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.queenslandsothebysrealty.com](https://www.queenslandsothebysrealty.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bestpropertyagent.com.au](https://www.bestpropertyagent.com.au/home/blog/what-residential-sales-agency-is-best-for-premium-suburbs-in-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## The shortlist

![The ultimate family retreat bringing Palm Springs glamour to New Farm • Ray White](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/buDpFJDpI_9l3JP0YPA0ShLyhUErUmrXWXEWipFMIc8dTm7Wcomd6PO-tiO1IpMRytG1KGOIO8RYBKvwUmwAX7WL6hBXeDNcAsmZxQrnaM06STme-Ck3JyvSrwP8Lwu3PTKB7Z-XeKpEDHLkVZ9cXCuPXbS3_VJF6qz2RxO5y4mCEpJbemJMryfKrj8TnKX9?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Ray White Collective Luxury

(Best for ultra-luxury homes)

**Why it stands out\:** This is a specialist luxury operation led by Matt Lancashire, focused exclusively on properties valued at \$4 million and above. The team highlights bespoke marketing, access to high-net-worth buyers and a strong record of major Brisbane sales, including several above \$10 million. [www.raywhite.com](https://www.raywhite.com/news-media/matt-lancashire-launches-new-era-ray-white-collective-luxury?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.raywhite.com](https://www.raywhite.com/the-white-report/brisbanes-most-decorated-luxury-agent-marks-20-years-with-ray-white?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best suited to\:** Trophy homes, riverfront estates and premium properties in New Farm, Hamilton and Ascot.

Website: [Ray White Collective Luxury](https://www.raywhite.com/news-media/matt-lancashire-launches-new-era-ray-white-collective-luxury)

## 2\. Queensland Sotheby's International Realty

(Best for international exposure)

**Why it stands out\:** Its international luxury-brand network and premium media partnerships can help position exceptional Brisbane properties in front of interstate and overseas buyers. The business also offers concierge-style services and operates across Queensland's prestige markets. ## 3\. Place Estate Agents

(Best for local Brisbane reach)

**Why it stands out\:** Place is a prominent Brisbane-focused residential agency with a broad local network. Its combination of suburb-level knowledge and reach across multiple Brisbane offices makes it worth considering for sellers who want strong local buyer competition. Industry coverage identifies it as one of the city's leading agencies. [www.bestpropertyagent.com.au](https://www.bestpropertyagent.com.au/home/blog/what-residential-sales-agency-is-best-for-premium-suburbs-in-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.realtorvibes.com](https://www.realtorvibes.com/brisbane-real-estate-agents-10-best-agencies-ranked-and-trusted-for-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best suited to\:** Premium family homes, contemporary residences and character properties across Brisbane's inner suburbs and blue-chip neighbourhoods.

## 4\. North South Prestige

**Why it stands out\:** A boutique, premium-focused option based in Brisbane's CBD, with a stated reach extending to the Gold Coast, Byron Bay and international luxury markets. Its positioning makes it especially relevant for clients considering premium apartments and investment-grade properties.

**Best suited to\:** CBD and riverfront apartments, luxury residences and clients who prefer a more boutique agency relationship.

---

![ARC Residences New Apartments at 570 Coronation Drive, Toowong - realestate.com.au](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/10WDL_BV1MuIof-c2Gt8Xteyrrl4V7Up0Z33BNj8TcraztiZKm2W5kUY32N26QLY0CzQ8FfrrFUeFSsfoJaHt8bXidiMAQN9JfclcG354rSjYClzeaY_HInwUgF6tNUxkcz6_to-lqNGUwx725JrfgtsdqZZQ38MGPOTV-14qc2zAo5Rg3zVtuhCPZj4kRcC?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. Adcock Prestige

**Why it stands out\:** A prestige-oriented agency associated with principal Jason Adcock. Its focus includes luxury homes, architectural properties, riverfront residences and premium apartments, with tailored marketing aimed at attracting buyers beyond the immediate suburb.

**Best suited to\:** High-end homes in Brisbane's inner west, distinctive architectural properties and sellers seeking specialist representation.

---

![49 Reading Street, Paddington, QLD 4064 - House for Sale - Ray White New Farm](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cxAoF1SZWDE5mSI6lqaNINUogOSmUK_zpDZvZf8Q69MP7kajF888_9f3BxxhcY2_OpUiVjIa5Vw0xfAnqMGp1Pa8fT5-hNWdxP-nBYU6iFMZK4Ts5MTNgyOLId9I3YIridX9WeaWSeJo0nFHgsVhRlfSR0ZaRO1RayrwLVET5EJx-Fx69MTbgHWxOh5N5CBR?purpose=fullsize)

## 6\. McGrath Estate Agents

**Why it stands out\:** Another agency worth interviewing for premium residential sales, particularly if you're considering character homes and established inner-west suburbs. Its broader brand and sales network provide an alternative to the more tightly luxury-specialised agencies above. [www.bestpropertyagent.com.au](https://www.bestpropertyagent.com.au/home/blog/what-residential-sales-agency-is-best-for-premium-suburbs-in-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.realtorvibes.com](https://www.realtorvibes.com/brisbane-real-estate-agents-10-best-agencies-ranked-and-trusted-for-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best suited to\:** Character homes, renovated Queenslanders and premium family properties around Paddington and Brisbane's inner west.

Website: [McGrath](https://www.mcgrath.com.au/)

## How I’d choose between them

| If your priority is… | First agency I’d interview |
|--------|--------|
| A property worth \$4m–\$20m+ | Ray White Collective Luxury |
| Overseas and interstate buyers | Queensland Sotheby’s International Realty |
| Strong local Brisbane buyer competition | Place Estate Agents |
| A boutique approach to premium apartments | North South Prestige |
| Architectural homes and inner-west prestige | Adcock Prestige |




## Before signing an agency agreement

I’d ask each finalist for three things\:

- **Comparable sales\:** three to five recent sales of properties similar to yours, in the same suburb and price bracket.
- **A specific marketing plan\:** how they will reach qualified buyers, what the campaign costs and whether an off-market strategy makes sense.
- **The actual lead agent\:** who will negotiate, manage inspections and communicate with you throughout the campaign.

One important distinction: a prestigious brand doesn't automatically mean the individual agent is the best fit. The quality of their recent comparable sales and their proposed strategy for your particular property should carry the most weight.

If you tell me which Brisbane suburb you're interested in and the approximate property value, I can narrow this to the strongest three agencies for that specific market. You can also explore [prestige agents by suburb](f) or [agencies for $5m+ properties](f)\.

search_results.title: Ray White TMG Luxury launches amid Gold Coast market downturn
search_results.description: Ray White TMG Luxury has launched amid a downturn in the Gold Coast property market, marked by four interest rate hikes, Middle East conflict, and changes to federal property tax policies. Ray White chief economist Nerida Conisbee remarked on the market’s uncertainty, though noting it is currently easier to transact. The launch featured a premium Broadbeach Waters property at 29 Namatjira Court with 95m of river frontage, 533 sq m of luxury living space, and high-end amenities such as a cocktail lounge and riverside pool. Despite a 3% decline in overall Gold Coast property values over the past year, the luxury segment in Broadbeach Waters remains resilient, mirroring stabilizing trends in Sydney’s Eastern suburbs and Melbourne’s South Yarra and Toorak. The event also marked the official unveiling of Ray White TMG Luxury, a new prestige-focused division led by CEO Matt Micallef. Micallef emphasized the division’s goal to provide a specialist approach for high-end buyers and sellers, asserting the Gold Coast's legitimacy as a top-tier luxury market. The luxury brand aims to respond to growing demand with dedicated, high-caliber service.

search_results.title: Graya breaks ground on Brisbane's most expensive house in New Farm
search_results.description: Celebrity developers Graya have commenced construction on a lavish mansion dubbed “Ivory,” on an exclusive riverfront block in New Farm, Brisbane, purchased by Chemist Warehouse boss Jeff Wasley and his wife Tanya for a record-breaking $25 million in 2025. Designed and built by Graya over 11 months, the home is expected to be worth between $40-$50 million upon completion. The 688 sqm site was previously owned by Graya co-founder Rob Gray and originally intended as his personal residence before it was sold for a $16.5 million profit. Ivory features a five-storey design including high-end amenities such as a luxury car showroom with river views, resort-style pools, rooftop entertainment areas, a wellness center, state-of-the-art golf simulator, and a master suite with 10-meter wardrobes. The house boasts a sleek, neutral finish with white, curved terraces and mushroom-style pillars. Located between New Farm Park and the Story Bridge, the property offers panoramic views of Brisbane’s skyline. This milestone build reflects Graya’s continued influence in Brisbane's luxury real estate market. The Wasleys had previously acquired another Graya-built home in Hamilton for $12.5 million.

search_results.title: Aria's Sanctuary Residences: $519m sold before public launch
search_results.description: Aria Property Group has reported a record-breaking pre-launch success for its Sanctuary Residences project in South Brisbane, achieving $519 million in apartment sales, making it Queensland’s largest apartment launch to date. Remarkably, sales were made without any public advertising, focusing on high-end three and four-bedroom apartments priced from $2.72 million and $4.01 million. Of the 231 apartments available in the first tower, only 86 remain unsold. Designed for buyers seeking spacious, luxurious homes without downsizing, the project has attracted strong interest. The development at 164-190 Melbourne Street includes restoration of two heritage buildings and features expansive amenities such as a wellness club, rooftop bar, and 2.9-meter ceilings. It is part of a larger master-planned precinct with public parks, laneways, and retail spaces. The first tower is set to complete by mid-to-late 2029, aligning with Brisbane's preparation for the 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games. This overwhelming response reflects growing demand for high-quality apartment living in Brisbane. The remaining units will be publicly released on October 19, with potential price increases expected.

search_results.title: Villa Alcyone: Award-winning Elanora mansion eyes suburb record
search_results.description: Villa Alcyone, a Mediterranean-style mansion situated on a steep 890 sqm block at 6 Bicton Ct in Elanora, has entered the market with expectations to surpass the suburb's sales record by millions. Designed by Jayson Pate and built by Resolve Constructions, the award-winning home reflects a growing trend of luxury builders tackling challenging vertical sites. The property garnered multiple accolades at the 2026 HIA Gold Coast and Northern Rivers Awards and a Master Builders Queensland award. The four-bedroom, four-bathroom home spans 579 sqm and features high-end finishes such as Italian marble, dramatic archways, and a Sukabumi stone pool, all inspired by European influences during the owners' travels. Interior design was led by co-owner Helen Foukkare. Positioned to maximize ocean views and offering access to popular nearby beaches like Currumbin and Palm Beach, the mansion is drawing interest from high-end buyers typically focused on more traditionally prestigious areas. Although quarterly data shows a slight dip in Elanora home prices, the suburb's annual values rose 14.7 percent, reflecting its evolving luxury market appeal. The Foukkares are already planning another unique luxury build in the Gold Coast region.

search_results.title: Inside Katanga: Hamilton's grand 1884 riverfront estate for sale
search_results.description: Katanga, a prestigious 1884 riverfront estate in Hamilton, Brisbane, is now on the market after an extensive transformation blending historical charm with modern luxury. Located at 25 Langside Road on a 1113 m² plot, the home has been thoughtfully redesigned by Twohill & James, maintaining its original heritage while introducing contemporary, lift-connected living across three levels. Current owners Sam and Brad Hopper, who previously owned a prominent Sunshine Beach property, sought to honor the home's history through elegant updates, including Calacatta Viola marble and travertine finishes. The residence features five ensuite bedrooms, including a luxurious parents' retreat, a self-contained guest wing, and numerous leisure amenities such as a gym, sauna, cinema, alfresco terrace, wet-edge pool, and heated spa. The impressive kitchen and entertaining areas integrate seamlessly with modern family functionality, while features such as a 10-car garage, dual EV chargers, and private office further enhance its appeal. With its sweeping river views and seamless blend of old and new, Katanga is a rare Brisbane gem now ready for new owners.

search_results.title: Queensland's Property Power List 2026: Who made the top 10?
search_results.description:
The Courier-Mail’s 2026 Queensland Property Power List highlights the top 100 most influential individuals shaping the state’s property and infrastructure landscape. At the pinnacle is Deputy Premier Jarrod Bleijie, whose decisive planning and housing policy reforms are streamlining approvals and reducing industry costs. Premier David Crisafulli follows closely, driving statewide housing strategies and Olympic infrastructure planning. Stephen Conry (GIICA Chair) oversees Olympic venue developments with a $7.1 billion budget, while Stuart Wood leads a critical union inquiry reshaping construction site governance. Industry veterans like Mark Stockwell, Don O’Rorke, and Damien Walker are pivotal in unlocking key housing and precinct developments.

The top 10 list includes leaders from government, private sector, unions, and industry groups directly influencing property development, planning, investment, and infrastructure delivery in the lead-up to the 2032 Brisbane Olympics. Their collective power lies in legislative authority, capital access, market influence, and project delivery, tackling Queensland’s housing crisis and fast-tracking growth. The full list spans developers, architects, government officials, union leaders, and real estate agents, acknowledging those directing both policy and physical transformation across the state’s residential, commercial, and infrastructure sectors.

**Why it stands out\:** A boutique, premium-focused option based in Brisbane's CBD, with a stated reach extending to the Gold Coast, Byron Bay and international luxury markets. Its positioning makes it especially relevant for clients considering premium apartments and investment-grade properties.

**Best suited to\:** CBD and riverfront apartments, luxury residences and clients who prefer a more boutique agency relationship.

## 5\. Adcock Prestige

**Why it stands out\:** A prestige-oriented agency associated with principal Jason Adcock. Its focus includes luxury homes, architectural properties, riverfront residences and premium apartments, with tailored marketing aimed at attracting buyers beyond the immediate suburb.

**Best suited to\:** High-end homes in Brisbane's inner west, distinctive architectural properties and sellers seeking specialist representation.

items.markdown:
## Before signing an agency agreement

I’d ask each finalist for three things\:

- **Comparable sales\:** three to five recent sales of properties similar to yours, in the same suburb and price bracket.
- **A specific marketing plan\:** how they will reach qualified buyers, what the campaign costs and whether an off-market strategy makes sense.
- **The actual lead agent\:** who will negotiate, manage inspections and communicate with you throughout the campaign.

One important distinction: a prestigious brand doesn't automatically mean the individual agent is the best fit. The quality of their recent comparable sales and their proposed strategy for your particular property should carry the most weight.

If you tell me which Brisbane suburb you're interested in and the approximate property value, I can narrow this to the strongest three agencies for that specific market. You can also explore [prestige agents by suburb](f) or [agencies for $5m+ properties](f)\.
